title: 第30章 越了解，越震惊！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
弟子！

    这个结论，远比之前的任何一个猜测，都更加合乎逻辑，也更加令人震撼！

    它完美地解释了所有的问题。

    为什么刘安一个汉代王爷，会知道一个秦朝上卿的“洞府”？

    因为那是他老师的！

    为什么他要以自己的名义，修建这座“陵墓”？

    因为他是在为自己的老师，完成某种仪式，或者说，是在守护老师的“道体”！

    为什么他编撰的《淮南子》中，蕴含着如此深邃的宇宙观和哲学思想？

    因为那根本就不是凡人的智慧，而是“仙人”的知识！

    为什么他最后会选择“假死脱身”？

    因为他完成了自己的使命，要去追寻老师的脚步，踏上那条真正的长生大道！

    一条清晰无比，但又惊世骇俗的故事线，出现在了所有人的眼前。

    【我的天！所以刘安是顾长青的徒弟？这辈分……汉武帝得管秦始皇的顾问叫师叔？】

    【这关系太乱了，我得缓缓……所以汉武帝派霍去病来挖的，是他师叔的坟？】

    【这下就说得通了！徒弟给师父修仙办事，结果皇帝外甥过来捣乱，还想抢秘籍，师父（或者师父留下的后手）一生气，就把他们团灭了！合情合理！】

    【我宣布，这就是标准答案！谁赞成，谁反对？】

    【刘安：我为师父守关两千年，你们却只关心我的八卦。】

    直播间的弹幕，已经彻底变成了大型历史同人创作现场。

    而演播厅里，张建国和金世昌两位老教授，在经历了最初的震惊之后，脸上都露出了恍然大悟的神情。

    “原来如此……原来如此啊！”

    张教授喃喃自语，“怪不得《汉书》里说刘安‘为人多智，好奇言怪’，又说他‘招致宾客方术之士数千人’。我们一直以为他只是叶公好龙，没想到，他是在为自己的师门，招揽人才，传承道法！”

    “难怪，难怪这个大阵能维持两千年不息！”

    金世昌也激动地说道，“如果刘安是传承者，那他必然懂得如何维护，甚至加固这个大阵！这也就解释了，为什么地宫的很多外部结构，带有汉代的风格，而核心的玉棺和阵法，却是纯正的先秦古物！这是两代人，跨越了上百年的共同杰作！”

    所有的线索，在这一刻，都完美地串联了起来。

    一个跨越了秦汉两代，隐藏在历史长河之中的修仙传承，就这样赤裸裸地展现在了世人面前。

    现场，林薇的内心，同样翻江倒海。

    “传承者……”
content_en:
disciple!

    This conclusion is far more logical and shocking than any previous guess!

    It explains everything perfectly.

    Why would Liu An, a prince of the Han Dynasty, know about the "cave house" of a Qin Dynasty minister?

    Because it belongs to his teacher!

    Why did he build this "mausoleum" in his own name?

    Because he was completing a certain ritual for his teacher, or in other words, he was protecting the teacher's "Tao body"!

    Why does his "Huainanzi" contain such profound cosmology and philosophical thoughts?

    Because that is not the wisdom of mortals at all, but the knowledge of "immortals"!

    Why did he choose to "fake death to escape" in the end?

    Because he has completed his mission and is going to follow in the footsteps of his teacher and embark on the real road to immortality!

    An extremely clear, yet shocking story line appeared before everyone's eyes.

    【Oh My God! So Liu An is Gu Changqing's apprentice? At this level... Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty had to call Qin Shihuang's advisor his uncle? 】

    [This relationship is too messy, I have to slow down... So what Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty sent Huo Qubing to dig was his uncle's grave? 】

    [Now it makes sense! The apprentice was working for the master to cultivate immortality, but the emperor's nephew came to cause trouble and wanted to steal the secret book. When the master (or the master's back-up man) got angry, he wiped them out! It makes sense! 】

    [I declare that this is the standard answer! Who is in favor and who is against? 】

    [Liu An: I have guarded the gate for Master for two thousand years, but you only care about my gossip. 】

    The barrage in the live broadcast room has completely turned into a large-scale historical fan creation scene.

    In the studio, two old professors, Zhang Jianguo and Jin Shichang, had expressions of enlightenment on their faces after experiencing the initial shock.

    "That's it...that's it!"

    Professor Zhang murmured to himself, "No wonder the Book of Han said that Liu An was 'a man of great wisdom and curious and eccentric,' and that he 'attracted thousands of guests and magicians.' We always thought he was just Ye Gong who loved dragons, but we didn't expect that he was recruiting talents for his own disciples and passing on Taoism!"

    "No wonder, no wonder this formation can last for two thousand years!"

    Jin Shichang also said excitedly, "If Liu An is the inheritor, then he must know how to maintain and even strengthen this formation! This also explains why many of the external structures of the underground palace have the style of the Han Dynasty, but the core jade coffins and formations are pure pre-Qin antiquities! This is the joint masterpiece of two generations, spanning hundreds of years!"

    All the clues, at this moment, were perfectly connected.

    A legacy of cultivating immortality that spanned the Qin and Han dynasties and was hidden in the long river of history was now nakedly displayed in front of the world.

    At the scene, Lin Wei's heart was also turned upside down.

    "The inheritor..."
title_en: Chapter 30 The more you understand, the more shocked you become!
